News.Title: TOU Mega Chujowe Extension v1.0.0
Text: ★ <link=https://github.com/HekerB/TownOfUsMegaChujoweExtension/releases>Download Latest Release</link> ★ <link=https://github.com/HekerB/TownOfUsMegaChujoweExtension>GitHub Repository</link> ★
Version 1.0.0 is finally here!
<size=105%>Crewmate:</size>
- Vanisher - fixed bug where players were unable to use the Vanish button
- Falcon - replaced zoom in/out button icons with a single one
- Bodyguard - added sacrifice animation in meetings, fixed being able to kill the protected player, improved shield and nameplate marker rendering
- Evoker - fixed inability to click map/tasks/doors during blind and fixed global verification limit per game not being respected
- Vampire Hunter - fixed incorrectly granting crewmate power and protective
- President - definitive fix for vote bank system, added tutorial image, fixed banner visibility
<size=105%>Neutral:</size>
- Pelican - complete rework: added swallow counter, fixed Investigator footprints, fixed huge range, fixed anti-cheat kicks during digestion, restored UI refresh after death, fixed instant ghost bug
- Doppelganger - fixed kill button cooldown not decreasing while in vents
- Shroud - fixed marker visibility and placement logic
- Lawyer - reworked Objection: now shows your own character, added sound fade-out, fixed client marker visibility
- Pirate - added tutorial image, fixed ties counting as win, fixed button blocking during duel
- Bounty Hunter - added target counter, fixed target marker refresh and visibility bug
- Pope - fixed win condition, added Hex Master death animation, fixed screen flashing during meetings, added marker visibility
- Shifter - fixed Assassin modifier exploit for Amnesiacs
<size=105%>Impostor:</size>
- Kamikaze - fixed kill detection, reworked explosion radius to use RC-XD light scaling, changed sphere color to orange, added round 1 suicide protection
- Wraith - fixed lantern visibility bug and added a small delay to ensure Swooper modifier applies before teleporting
- Poisoner - added poison body animation, fixed poisoned players not dying in meetings
- Witch - fixed curse marker rendering and visibility
- Outlaw - fixed kill button
- RC-XD - improved car rendering and sync, fixed body/shield/target marker persistence
<size=105%>Modifiers & Mechanics:</size>
- Death Note - fixed numerous bugs and improved overall stability
- Guessing System - Venomous and Death Note are now guessable based on their individual toggles
- Lovers - added toggle option for Lover Chat during meetings
<size=105%>Game Modes & UI:</size>

- Draft Mode - complete system overhaul with polished UI, added Random Neutral (70/15/15 logic), added Legacy Mode (picking from all classes) and Respect Role Chances, fixed spectators being included in pick order
- Localization - added Full Polish Support with Local Settings toggle
- Lobby Options - significant reorganization and rework of many option groups
<size=105%>Other:</size>
- Wiki Overhaul - added detailed terminology with new icons (Lawyer, Medic, Jackal, Shield Flashes)
- Wiki Settings - added Hacker icon and real-time display for Draft Mode
- Fixed Crewmate abilities (Evoker, Falcon, Mirage, etc.) not working during communications sabotage
- Cleaned up redundant RPC calls and improved Host-side synchronization
- Optimized mod size (36MB -> 14MB)
- Most importantly: fixed old bugs and added new ones!

Version 1.0.5 - Stability & Role Reworks
<size=105%>Shield System & Bodyguard Fixes:</size>

- DEFINITIVE Shield Fix - Fixed a critical issue where Sheriff and Officer could hit protected players without triggering any notifications or flashes. This was caused by hardcoded shield checks in the base Town of Us mod that we now successfully intercept.
- Centralized Shield Logic - Moved all shield hit processing (flashes, RPCs, cooldowns) to a unified ShieldUtils system, ensuring 100% consistency across all killing roles.
- Mirror-Style Flashes - Reworked the screen flash effect to match the official Mirrorcaster logic. It now uses a dedicated renderer for a cleaner, high-quality visual response.
- Bodyguard Retaliation - Fixed the retaliation window: Bodyguards now reliably receive alerts when their target is hit by Sheriff, Officer, or Vampire Hunter.
<size=105%>Role & Logic Reworks:</size>
- Serial Killer - Added progressive Maniac Timer Reduction option. The Maniac timer now decreases after each kill, with a configurable floor (limit).
- Vampire Hunter - Killing a Vampire now restores 1 stake charge instead of just not consuming one, preventing bugs with charge UI synchronization.
- Wraith Swoop - Swoop sound effect is now local only (only the Wraith hears it), preventing everyone on the map from knowing the Wraith's location.
- Poisoner - Removed the annoying 'banger' screen shake effect when poisoning players.
<size=105%>Stability & Fixes:</size>
- Imitator - Fixed UI buttons disappearing when players died mid-meeting.
- Pope - Synchronized win priority during Judgement to prevent desync wins.
- Forestaller - Fixed visibility in guesser menus based on task completion status.
- General - Optimized internal RPC handling and updated intro sounds for improved performance.

Text: ★ <link=https://github.com/HekerB/TownOfUsMegaChujoweExtension/releases>Download Latest Release</link> ★ <link=https://github.com/HekerB/TownOfUsMegaChujoweExtension>GitHub Repository</link> ★
Version 1.0.6 - Mirage, Time Lord & Forensic Updates
<size=105%>Mirage Decoy Fixes & Rework:</size>
- Dynamic Interaction Range - FIXED "shot" interactions (Sheriff, Shroud, etc.) not triggering decoys from a distance. The decoy now correctly detects interactions based on the button's range.
- Proximity Trigger - Added a "touch" interaction. Walking into a decoy now correctly triggers it, providing a reliable fallback for all interaction types.

- Robust Role Detection - Improved meeting feedback. Even if role data is unsynced, the interactor is now correctly identified (falling back to class names) to prevent "No players interacted" false negatives.
- Interaction Polish - Optimized decoy destruction logic to prevent double-triggers and improved sync across all clients.
<size=105%>Time Lord Updates:</size>
- Rewind Speed Multiplier - Added a new option to the Modifiers menu to control the speed of the rewind animation (0.5x - 5.0x).
- Dynamic Timing - Rewind duration and internal event schedules (revives, body restorations, task undos) now dynamically scale to match the chosen speed multiplier.
- Wiki Integration - The current speed multiplier is now displayed in the Time Lord's advanced description in the Wiki.
- Reliability - Physical movement and snapshot popping are perfectly synchronized with the speed multiplier, ensuring players always rewind exactly by the amount of history seconds set in the lobby.
<size=105%>Forensic Updates:</size>

- Freeze Scenes on Meeting - Added a new lobby option. If enabled, crime scenes will stop tracking new suspects once a meeting starts. This ensures players aren't wrongly identified as suspects for old murders if the body remains on the map in subsequent rounds.
- UI Polish - Updated Forensic UI color to Deep Orchid and moved the role to the bottom of the modifiers list (priority 999).
<size=105%>Mayor & President Updates:</size>
- Mayor Votes - Fully reworked the vote count system. Mayor now correctly supports 3-10 votes as configured in the lobby options, bypassing base mod overrides.

- President-Monarch Integration - Finally allowed the President to be knighted by the Monarch. Added a Smart Injection System: bonus votes are now manually injected only on the first click, preserving the President's vote bank.
- President HUD Feedback - Added a dynamic vote counter to the meeting timer HUD for the President, displaying current bank votes and Monarch bonuses.
- Localization - Added full English and Polish support for all new President and Mayor UI elements.

News.SubTitle: Vampire, Egotist & Quality of Life
News.Title: TOU Mega Chujowe Extension v1.0.7
Text: ★ <link=https://github.com/HekerB/TownOfUsMegaChujoweExtension/releases>Download Latest Release</link> ★ <link=https://github.com/HekerB/TownOfUsMegaChujoweExtension>GitHub Repository</link> ★
Version 1.0.7 - Vampire Rework & Quality of Life
★ MAJOR CHANGE: VAMPIRE REWORK ★
- Vampire Sabotage - Finalized the sabotage system. Vampires now use a stable, TAB-only sabotage interaction and are restricted to Lights to maintain map stability during meetings.
- New Option: Can Only Sabotage Lights - Added a dedicated toggle in the Better Roles tab to restrict Vampire sabotage exclusively to Lights.
<size=105%>Better Roles/Modifiers Tab:</size>
- New Sidebar Tab - Centralized all extension options for existing roles (Vampire, Egotist, Forensic, Mayor, Sonar, Time Lord) into a dedicated Better Roles/Modifiers tab.
- Aesthetic Prefixes - Added "Better role: " and "Better modifier: " prefixes to clearly distinguish between standard settings and extension features.
- Alphabetical Sorting - Enforced strict alphabetical order in both the Lobby settings sidebar and the Wiki documentation for better navigability.
<size=105%>Role & Modifier Improvements:</size>
- Ventable Fix - FIXED Usage Logic: entering and exiting a vent now correctly consumes only 1 usage for the entire action.
- Oracle Improvements - Fixed a bug where Oracle's Bless acted as a physical shield. Added screen flash effects for both exile and guess protection to ensure visual feedback for all involved players.
- RC-XD Improvements - Added a toggle to restrict car deployment to the first round only.
- Hacker Balancing - Reworked Jam Charges: initial charges can now be set to Infinite (hides UI counter). Removed redundant options (Max Charges, Charges per Kill) for a cleaner configuration.
- Shifter Fix - Fixed a bug where Shifter was able to steal Chef and Inquisitor (Neutral Outlier) roles.
<size=105%>Draft Mode & Vampire Hunter Polish:</size>

- Reduce Killing Streak - Consolidated streak reduction into a single, user-friendly toggle. Added support for Neutral Killing roles and a configurable Reduction Chance (0-100%), allowing you to fine-tune the probability of players becoming killers multiple times in a row.
- VH Uses Logic Fixed - Stake button now correctly consumes a charge only on a failed stake (hitting a non-vampire). Successful vampire kills are now free of charge, as originally intended.
- VH Report Button Polish - When standing near your own victim, the Report button is now greyed out instead of disappearing. This matches standard Among Us behavior.
- VH Visual Feedback - The Stake button now correctly desaturates (turns grey) when no targets are in range or when out of charges.
- Merge Neutrals with Crew - Added a feature that allows Neutral Benign, Evil, and Outlier (e.g., Chef, Inquisitor) roles to occasionally appear in the Crewmate selection pool.
- Full Polish Support - Localized strings for all new Draft options, Better Roles tab, and Vampire settings.

- Serial Killer Win Rework - Fixed 1v1 standoffs. Serial Killer now correctly wins at parity against passive crew (e.g. Engineer). Standoffs with Power Crew (Veteran, Vigilante) are respected based on lobby settings.
- Hacker Audio Polish - Jam activation sound is now audible only to Impostors and Crewpostors, allowing for better coordinated attacks.
- Egotist Vent Rework - Fixed exit cooldown (now triggers immediately on exit) and added a visual timer/radial CD to the vent button.
- Pirate Win Screen Fix - Pirates now correctly show "Victorious" (Zwyciestwo) instead of "Ejected" on the end-game screen.
- Polish Localization Update - Added missing end-game status strings for winning and ejection reasons.

Version 1.0.8 - Mirror Caster & Stability Breakthrough

- Duplicate Guard 2.0 - Fully stabilized detection system for duplicated mod files. Detects files like TouMegaChujoweExtension (1).dll and prevents lobby crashes.
- System Notification - Kicked players trigger a professional, black 'System' chat bubble exclusively on the Host's screen, matching the native TOU style.
- Visual Warning - Displays a red warning on the Main Menu if a duplicate is found and prevents joining unstable lobbies.
★ Vampire & Roles Rework ★
- Vampire Sabotage Map - The TAB sabotage map is now 100% functional for Vampires! Properly overrides Impostor cooldowns and features a custom radial cooldown ring.
- Vampire Hunter - Fixed self-report logic and stake targeting to eliminate random compilation errors and mid-game crashes.
- Vampire Sabotage Update - Reworked the Light Sabotage system. Vampires now share a unified sabotage cooldown with Impostors for better balance.
- Mirror Caster - Added WASD/Joystick movement while targeting and optimized UI responsiveness.
★ Extreme Stability & Optimization ★
- IL2CPP Compatibility - Fixed "Assembly not registered" crashes by isolating all custom role coroutines (Wraith, Hacker, Vulture, Kamikaze, StakeButton, etc.).
- Memory Leak Prevention - Eliminated the "Death Loop" of NullReferenceExceptions in UI buttons (Falcon, Egotist) that was causing OutOfMemory crashes.
- Lover Chat Safety - Added robust null-checks for meeting chat RPCs to prevent crashes when players disconnect.
- Localization Safety - Fixed a hard crash in the Mayor and Better Roles tabs when certain strings were missing.

Text: ★ <link=https://github.com/HekerB/TownOfUsMegaChujoweExtension/releases>Download Latest Release</link> ★ <link=https://github.com/HekerB/TownOfUsMegaChujoweExtension>GitHub Repository</link> ★
Version 1.0.9 - Bounty Hunter & Victory UI Fixes
★ Role Fixes & Reworks ★
- Bounty Hunter - added Weighted Targets (10% higher bias towards non-crewmate roles). Fixed win-condition in Win With Winners mode (immediate death/spectator victory).
- Shifter / Imitator - FIXED a critical bug where players who had their role stolen by a Shifter retained their previous role. Ensured proper role cleanup and transition sync.
- Win Notifications - added localized chat alerts for all players when a Bounty Hunter achieves victory.
★ Universal Victory UI Fix ★
- Ejected Bug FIXED - resolved a widespread bug where custom neutral winners (Pelican, BH, Vulture, etc.) were incorrectly labeled as "Ejected" on the end-game screen.
- Summary Integration - added "Victorious" labels to the end-game summary sidebar records for all extension winners.
- Themed Status Labels - statuses above player heads now use the role's specific team color and preserve gold nickname colors for winners.
★ Anti-Cheat & Stability ★
- Duplicate Guard Alerts - fixed the system notification for duplicated mod files. The Host now reliably receives a styled black 'System' bubble without UI errors.
- RPC & Networking Fixes - handled edge cases for Host-side duplicate mod detection and rapid player disconnections.
- Localization - updated Polish and English strings for all new victory scenarios, notifications, and end-game statuses.
★ Draft Mode Overhaul ★
- Global Neutral Limits - Added global Min/Max limits for Neutral roles, providing better control over game balance.
- Smart Distribution - Implemented 70/30 probability bias for neutral roles and forced neutral selection when minimum game requirements are met.
- Unified UI - Streamlined lobby configuration for Draft Mode with a more intuitive layout.
★ Shield & Role Updates ★
- Shield Bypass - Plaguebearer (Plague) now correctly bypasses all shields when performing an infect action.
- Shield Consistency - Unified shield logic to ensure Warden and Cleric interactions are correctly handled for all roles.
- Chef Fixes - Fixed Chef's "Cook" ability proximity targeting and stabilized role-switching with Imitator.
- Jailor Fixes - Resolved meeting UI stability issues and interaction bugs for the Jailor.
★ Stability & Security ★
- Duplicate Mod Guard - Optimized duplicate detection to use Host-only RPCs and custom 'System' chat alerts, preventing crashes and UI clutter.
- Meeting Stability - Fixed various UI flickering and lag spikes during meeting transitions.
★ Major Draft Neutral Distribution Rework ★
- Two-Tier Distribution - Separated global neutral game limits from the number of roles shown in the individual pick menus.
- Global Target (60/40) - The game pre-rolls a fixed number of neutrals for the entire round at the start (60% chance for Min / 40% for Max).
- Choice Mixing (60/40) - The number of neutral roles visible to a player (e.g., 1 or 2 out of 8) is now rolled independently for each picker.
- Guaranteed Selection - If the global target hasn't been met, the system will force only neutral roles for the last players, ensuring lobby balance.
- Optimization & All-Classes - Removed redundant toggles, unified 'All Classes' as the default standard, and eliminated draft lag with a new caching system.

News.SubTitle: Infiltrator (Jackal) Added
News.Title: TOU Mega Chujowe Extension v1.1.1
Text: ★ <link=https://github.com/HekerB/TownOfUsMegaChujoweExtension/releases>Download Latest Release</link> ★ <link=https://github.com/HekerB/TownOfUsMegaChujoweExtension>GitHub Repository</link> ★
Version 1.1.1 - Infiltrator (Jackal) & Sidekick Mechanics
★ NEW ROLE: INFILTRATOR (Neutral Outlier) ★
- Jackal Gameplay - Recruit two players from opposite teams to work for you. You win if your team is the last one standing.
- Sidekick Shield - While at least one Recruit (Sidekick) is alive, you are protected by a powerful shield.
- Assassination - You gain the ability to kill only AFTER all your recruits have died.
- Impostor Vision - See the world like an Impostor while remaining neutral.
- Deadly Bond - Recruits are Life-Linked; if one dies, the other follows shortly after.
★ Sidekick (Recruit) Mechanics ★
- Team Synergy - Recruits have white names and a special (REC) tag visible to the Infiltrator team.
- Private Chat - Access to a dedicated private chat during the game.
- Notification System - The Infiltrator receives a screen flash and alert when a Recruit dies.
★ NEW ROLE: PORTALMAKER (Crewmate) ★
- Teleportation - Place two portals to travel quickly across the map.
- Flexible Settings - Customize who can use the portals (Crewmate, Neutral, Impostor, or Everyone).
- Portal Limits - Configure custom placement cooldowns, teleports, and portal durations.
★ NEW ROLE: GARDENER (Crewmate Protective) ★
- Protective Garden - Plant a garden zone that shields all players inside from attacks.
- Visual Feedback - Receive real-time visual alerts and meeting logs when attacks are blocked.
- Task Integration - Option to earn garden uses by completing crewmate tasks.
★ NEW ROLE: ARCANIST (Neutral Outlier) ★
- Tarot Cards - Draw Tarot cards from your deck, each with a unique effect on you or the lobby.
- Game Changers - Cards can change your role (become Pope, Jester, Doomsayer, BH), modify stats, affect other players, or even kill you.
- Card Weights - Fully customize card draw weight and deck sizes in the lobby settings.
★ Improvements & Wiki ★
- Wiki Cleanup - Optimized the Wiki layout for Infiltrator and hidden technical modifiers.
- Localization - Full Polish support for all Infiltrator-related options and alerts.
- Bug Fixes - Resolved various compilation errors and stabilized role-switching logic.
★ Bounty Hunter Rework ★
- Suicide Penalty - BH now dies instantly (Guild Execution) if they kill anyone other than their target.
- Free Hunt - BH can now target anyone, making misclicks fatal and strategy more important.
- Tracker Range - Added new option to set arrow visibility (Short, Medium, Long, or Infinite).
- Vision Toggle - Added option to enable/disable Impostor Vision for BH.
★ Polish & Stability ★
- Team-Kill Prevention - Blocked targeting/killing between Jackal and Recruits.
- Intro Reveal - Sidekicks see a prominent RECRUIT title and mission info in the intro.
- Smart Highlighting - Shroud and Pelican buttons show a red glow when a target is in range, even on cooldown.
- Detonator Wiki Rework - updated Wiki with clean descriptions and 'Attach C4' label. Target now hears a beeping sound when detonation is ready.
- Pelican Wiki Rework - standardized terminology to 'Swallow' (Polknij) and polished all descriptions.
- Pope Balancing - limited canonization spread to a single transfer and reduced judge alarm volume (0.25f). Doctor can now cleanse the canonization modifier.
- RC-XD Meeting Fix - car now detonates instantly when a meeting or exile starts, preventing it from driving during discussions.
- Victory Status Fix - ensured custom neutral winners (BH, Pirate, etc.) correctly display 'Victorious' above their heads.
- Speedy Fix - camouflage now correctly applies to all players during acceleration.
- Jackal/Vampire Mutual Exclusion - implemented a 50/50 randomized exclusion for Standard mode and first-pick exclusion for Draft mode to prevent both roles from coexisting in the same match.
- Bounty Hunter Fixes - corrected Hunt button description stating you cannot kill other players, and added missing English translations for options (vision, arrow range).
- Mirror Caster Movement Fix - fixed movement bugs where players would slide indefinitely or move while typing in chat overlays (e.g., Lover Chat) with 'Can Move While Menu' enabled.
★ NEW ROLE: SNIPER (Impostor Killing) ★
- Remote Sniping - Use Snipe to enter aiming mode. Click on a target on your screen to eliminate them from afar.
- Aiming Mechanics - While aiming, you stand in place, but you gain a camera scroll to view the map. Zoom distance, Aim duration, Snipe cooldown, and Can Cancel options are fully configurable.
- Death Reason - Custom death reason (Sniped) with custom death feed translation.
- Safety Measures - Sniper aiming and camera states are properly cleared and restored if a meeting starts.
★ Poisoner Stabilizations ★
- Meeting Reset - Force-terminates seeking and vining phases during meetings, completely clearing the dark overlay shadow.
- Options Visibility - Dynamically toggles visibility of Vine options in the lobby menu based on configuration.
★ UI & Localization Polish ★
- Button Position - Realigned the Snipe button to match the bottom-left Detonator layout for maximum playability.

- Tab Newline Refinement - Fixed Sniper description newline rendering and systematically broke down long TabDescription lines for 10 custom roles (Trapper, Pope, Outlaw, Wraith, Hacker, Astral, Speedy, Detonator, Forestaller, Evoker) using native \%nl\% tags to ensure perfect layout styling.
★ NEW ROLE: SPIRIT MASTER (old Medium) (Crewmate Investigative) ★
- Spirit Mediation - Reworked classic Medium-style gameplay into a separate role that can mediate with dead players.
- Spirit Tracking - Links living and dead players with role-colored arrows until the next meeting.
- Custom Options - Configure mediate cooldown, reveal behavior, arrow visibility, and which dead player is revealed.
★ NEW ROLE: GUN GAME (Impostor Power) ★
- Role Mutation - Changes into a random non-power impostor role after the configured number of kills.
- Role Memory - Optional remembered-role pool can limit or recycle mutation targets, including infinite mode.
- Cooldown Safety - New role buttons and kill cooldowns now start with their configured timers after mutation.

News.SubTitle: Loner, Baker, Joker & Burrower
News.Title: TOU Mega Chujowe Extension v1.2
Text: <link=https://github.com/HekerB/TownOfUsMegaChujoweExtension/releases>Download Latest Release</link> | <link=https://github.com/HekerB/TownOfUsMegaChujoweExtension>GitHub Repository</link> | <link=https://discord.gg/qaQZAmAVh4>Discord</link>
Version 1.2 - Loner, Baker, Joker & Burrower Update
NEW ROLE: LONER (Impostor Power)
- Solo Start - Starts the match with one fewer Impostor teammate than the lobby setting.
- Meeting Recruit - Can recruit a living non-Impostor during meetings to restore the Impostor team.
- Recruit Options - Recruits can become Assassin, Traitor, or a normal Impostor depending on lobby settings.
- New Role After Kills - After recruiting, Loner can gain a random Impostor role after the configured number of kills.
- Balance Rules - Loner cannot become an Impostor Power or Impostor Killing role through mutation.
- UI Polish - Added meeting recruit buttons, cancel support, hover feedback, Loner tags, tab counter, and Draft support.
NEW ROLE: BAKER / FAMINE (Neutral Killing)
- Baker - Gives bread to living players. Breaded targets are marked for the Baker and trigger alerts when they die.
- Famine Transformation - Give enough bread to become Famine, with a configurable Instant Famine chance.
- Famine - Starts by starving breaded players. After all breaded players die, Famine becomes invincible and can starve anyone.
- Shield Rules - Starve respects protection effects, while Baker bread interactions give shield feedback instead of rewards.
- Cleanse Support - Cleric and Doctor cleanse can remove bread/starve effects.
- Polish - Added bread symbols, colored target names, death alerts, white flashes, Famine vent options, and a custom Starved death reason.
NEW ROLE: JOKER (Neutral Evil)
- Clone Gameplay - Places clones of living players. Joker wins after enough clones are killed.
- Clone Controls - Added max clone limits, clone uses left, and optional reset each meeting.
- Self Clone Tablet - The tablet can show all living players, including the Joker.
- Kill Detection - Clone kills are handled across Impostor, Neutral, Crewmate, Glitch, Parasite, and other kill-style interactions.
- Win Handling - Added Joker neutral win condition support and DiedToWinning handling when configured to win with others.
NEW ROLE: BURROWER (Impostor Concealing)
- Dig & Emerge - Digs underground, places linked vents, and emerges through the tunnel system.
- Placement Safety - Blocks unsafe wall placements and adjusts vents toward valid positions to avoid broken vent spots.
- Balanced Digging - Added prepare delay, forced stand-still placement, delayed underground cancel, and gradual underground acceleration.
- Options - Configure uses, dig speed, max underground speed, whether vents persist after meetings, and placement timing.
- Feedback - Added uses left display, Miner-style placement sound, and improved low-vision behavior while underground and after emerging.
GUN GAME & SPEEDY UPDATES

- Gun Game - Fixed stale role caches between games, added random role selection options, role memory limits, mutation alerts with the new role icon/name, and proper cooldown resets for all gained abilities.
- Speedy - Restored the classic acceleration buff flow and added a placeholder disabled ability button before the first upgrade.
ROLE POLISH & BALANCE
- Pope - Renamed abilities to Cream Cake and Sanctify, updated descriptions, refreshed assets, and temporarily changed the alarm sound to Hex Master's Hex Bomb sound.
- Shroud - Updated visuals and rewrote descriptions so the trap/visitor mechanic is easier to understand.
- Sage - Updated role icon and ability alert presentation.
- Detonator - Reworked button sprites and explosion feedback, keeping the attach/purse sprite instead of switching to detonate/recall.
- Portalmaker - Fixed portal visibility: portals are visible to everyone, while Who Can Use only controls teleport permission.
WIKI, README & CREDITS
- Documentation - Updated README and Wiki for Loner, Baker/Famine, Joker, Burrower, Gun Game, Spirit Master, Pope, Shroud, and new assets.
- Credits - Updated credits for CraftR, Atony / Town of Us: Mira / Town Of Us Discord, Xinav, Town of Salem-inspired Shroud assets, and free-sound sources.
- Release Links - Patch notes now include the Discord invite alongside Releases and the GitHub repository.

News.SubTitle: Apocalypse Update
News.Title: TOU Mega Chujowe Extension v1.2.2
Text: <link=https://github.com/HekerB/TownOfUsMegaChujoweExtension/releases>Download Latest Release</link> | <link=https://github.com/HekerB/TownOfUsMegaChujoweExtension>GitHub Repository</link> | <link=https://discord.gg/qaQZAmAVh4>Discord</link>
Version 1.2.2 - Apocalypse Update
NEW APOCALYPSE ROLE: SOUL COLLECTOR / DEATH
- Soul Collector - Reap living players to mark their souls. If a marked target dies before the deadline, Soul Collector gains a soul.
- Death Transformation - Collect enough souls to become Death, Horseman of the Apocalypse.
- Death - Becomes invincible, gains impostor vision, kills without teleporting, and leaves dark unreportable bodies.
- Cleanse Support - Doctor and Cleric cleanse can remove Reap marks before the target dies.
- Polish - Added role-colored target names, tab counters, death alerts, transformation meeting announcements, custom death reason, and new extension icons.
NEW APOCALYPSE ROLE: BERSERKER / WAR
- Berserker - A Neutral Apocalypse killer whose kill cooldown decreases after each kill.
- War Transformation - After enough kills, Berserker becomes War with configurable Instant War chance and transformation announcement.
- War - Becomes invincible, gains impostor vision, and can chain kills during a short spree window.
- War Can Vent - Added a simple toggle controlling whether War can use vents after transforming.
- Balance - Berserker is guessable before transforming, while War is protected like the other Horsemen.
NEUTRAL APOCALYPSE MECHANICS
- Apocalypse Wins Together - Added a shared win condition for Plaguebearer/Pestilence, Baker/Famine, Soul Collector/Death, and Berserker/War.
- Ally Rules - Apocalypse roles can be treated as allies: they share victory, cannot guess each other, and their roles are revealed to each other when the shared win option is enabled.
- Apocalypse Chat - Added a dedicated meeting chat for Apocalypse roles, now controlled from General settings.
- Friendly Targeting - Apocalypse roles respect alliance rules for hostile actions when Apocalypse Wins Together is enabled.
- Draft Terminology - Updated Draft terminology to explain Neutral Apocalypse roles and their shared mechanics.
APOCALYPSE POLISH & FIXES
- Vision Rules - Baker, Soul Collector, and Berserker no longer start with impostor vision, while Famine, Death, and War gain it after transforming.
- Shield Rules - Famine, Death, Berserker, and War interactions were checked against shield behavior for better consistency.
- UI Polish - Updated colors, icons, role descriptions, tab text, meeting alerts, and Apocalypse chat visuals.

Version 1.3.0.1 - Cause of Death & Famine Hotfix
BUG FIXES & STABILITY
- Cause of Death Bug (Suicide) - FIXED a major regression from the latest patch where every player's cause of death was incorrectly shown as "Suicide" due to a DeathHandler pre-initialization bug.
- Arcanist & Berserker Buttons - Fixed UI null-access crashes during round transitions by securing role lookups with local player checks.
- Jackal - Fixed Jackal self-killing bugs and ensured the IgnoreInvulnerabilityModifier is properly attached/removed to prevent unintended button/shield interactions.
BAKER & FAMINE

- Unlock Mechanics - Baker is now strictly limited to 1 kill max until Famine is unlocked. Adjusted TryUnlockFamine checks to ignore the Baker's starved state so that Famine unlocks even if 1 starved target remains alive.
- Famine Visual Feedback - Famine's starved targets now have colored nicknames and a custom symbol in the HUD, making it easier to track target status.
- Cleanse Support - Cleric and Doctor cleanse now correctly remove the Famine Starve Reveal modifier from targets.
- Famine Starve Button - Configured Famine's starve button to support infinite uses when configured.
DEPENDENCIES
- TownOfUsMira API - Updated dependency to the stable official release v1.6.2.
